pairs.prompt: Package the existing exam handbook Skill without losing its Python-backed generation capability.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

variant_a.output: The rule-only package contains SKILL.md, agents/, and references/, but no executable engine or runtime integrity contract.

variant_b.output: The standard package contains SKILL.md, agents/interface.yaml, the versioned engine wheel, runtime-lock.json, doctor.py, bootstrap_runtime.py, and run_runtime.py. The wheel payload matches 77/77 legacy source files.

pairs.prompt: Prove that the standard Skill keeps the existing command surface.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

rubric.description: Includes retrieval, review, and delivery commands.

variant_a.output: The rule-only package cannot run the legacy CLI, so command names, flags, help text, and exit codes are unavailable.

variant_b.output: The packaged adapter preserves 10/10 CLI help contracts: root plus discover, generate, extract-evidence, demo, review, export-pdf, audit-delivery, index-review-ledger, and inspect; arguments and exit codes pass through unchanged.

pairs.prompt: Show that a packaged run produces the same controlled artifacts as the legacy engine.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

variant_a.output: No packaged runtime is available, so artifact compatibility is unknown and cannot be executed from the Skill archive.

variant_b.output: A same-input dual run produced 25/25 matching normalized artifacts, with no missing, extra, or changed files. Both runs returned the same blocked state until LLM-owned teaching content is supplied.

pairs.prompt: Prevent PDF export before the current handbook HTML has passed complete LLM review.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

variant_a.output: The prose says to review HTML first, but the rule-only archive has no final-review, render-snapshot, ledger, or export implementation.

variant_b.output: The packaged engine keeps review, index-review-ledger, audit-delivery, and export-pdf. PDF export requires the exact current HTML, render snapshot, visual approvals, and review-ledger hashes; stale or pending state returns a blocking exit code.

pairs.prompt: Update the README and release assets for the exam handbook repository.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.
